3.3 ECU state management
During startup and shutdown the task of the BswM is to initialize all basic software
modules in a similar way as it is done by the ECUM in older AUTOSAR releases. To
achieve this the following ModeDeclarationGroup is defined, which indicates the
overall state of the ECU to application software components and is used for internal
rule arbitration.
modeGroup MDG_EcuMode {
ECU_RUN,
ECU_APP_RUN,
ECU_APP_POST_RUN,
ECU_GO_SLEEP,
ECU_GO_OFF_ONE,
ECU_SLEEP,
ECU_GO_OFF_TWO,
ECU_STARTUP_ONE,
ECU_STARTUP_TWO,
ECU_RESET_READY
}
interface modeSwitch MSIF_EcuMode {
mode MDG_EcuMode ecuMode
}
Listing 3.9: ModeDeclarationGroup for overall ECU state management
The initial mode of this ModeDeclarationGroup is ECU_STARTUP_ONE.
